actions.title: Read the audit-guard observation boundary
actions.instruction: This lesson observes one harmless blocked write against an existing append-only audit log. It does not ask you to execute an override, change an audit record, or claim that anyone approved a bypass.
actions.rationale: A failed pre-write attempt and an actual override are different events.
actions.expected_result: You know that `.codearbiter/overrides.log` stays unchanged and that the exercise commits only one local observation note.
actions.recovery: If any requested action would change an audit record, stop this lesson. Do not substitute an override command.
actions.evidence: Check binds repository bytes and one local event-shaped note. It cannot prove the refusal chronology; manual imitation remains possible.

actions.title: Prepare the bound U02 baseline
actions.instruction: At the clean Academy clone root, run Academy Prepare in a native terminal. Native-terminal commands go directly into that terminal and never begin with `!`.
actions.rationale: Prepare creates the numbered attempt and binds Check to the audit log's pre-observation bytes.
actions.expected_result: Academy creates one numbered U02 attempt with the audit-log baseline bound.
actions.recovery: If Prepare refuses or the clone is dirty, preserve its message and correct that setup condition. Do not manufacture an attempt or scenario file.
actions.evidence: The prepared commit is the source for the baseline digest Check derives.

actions.title: Inspect the bound audit-log baseline
actions.instruction: In the prepared attempt, inspect the current audit log through the selected harness shell. Harness shell commands begin with exactly one `!`; they are shell commands, not CodeArbiter commands.
actions.rationale: Recognize the protected target before observing the guard that prevents its rewrite.
actions.expected_result: You see a local baseline digest without changing the audit log.
actions.recovery: If the log is missing or the worktree is not clean, stop and Reset the attempt. Do not create or edit the log by hand.
actions.evidence: The displayed digest is orientation only. Check derives its own digest from the prepared commit.

actions.title: Observe the H-05 guarded restore refusal
actions.instruction: Run exactly one `git restore --source=HEAD` request in the harness shell, so it begins with one `!`. Prepare has proven the target equals HEAD, so the request is content-neutral if enforcement is unavailable. Do not retry it or use an override command.
actions.rationale: The real H-05 shell guard blocks Git restore because it can rewrite an audit log.
actions.expected_result: The active host prints one `BLOCKED [H-05]: ...` line before Git runs, and the audit log remains byte-for-byte unchanged.
actions.recovery: If the guard does not run, verify the log still equals HEAD, preserve the result, and stop for host-install investigation. Never edit the log to repair or hide the attempt.
actions.evidence: Capture the displayed H-05 line exactly. Its SHA-256 binds the note to that text, but the note cannot independently prove when the refusal happened.

actions.title: Draft one constrained observation note
actions.instruction: Ask the agent to draft `.codearbiter/reports/academy/U02-observation.md` from the displayed H-05 line and the bound baseline. It must contain the exact target, baseline SHA-256, event SHA-256, event_line, and the chronology limitation. Do not stage, commit, or push.
actions.rationale: A constrained note preserves an observation without touching protected audit history.

variants.command:
Create only .codearbiter/reports/academy/U02-observation.md. Write exactly these eight lines, each followed by LF:
# U02 audit-guard observation

event: H-05 guarded restore refusal
target: .codearbiter/overrides.log
baseline_sha256: <SHA-256 of the unchanged current .codearbiter/overrides.log UTF-8 bytes; Prepare bound it to HEAD>
event_sha256: <SHA-256 of the exact displayed BLOCKED [H-05] refusal line as UTF-8 bytes>
event_line: <that exact displayed line>
limitation: This record cannot prove the refusal chronology; manual imitation remains possible.

Do not stage, commit, push, or edit .codearbiter/overrides.log.

actions.expected_result: One unstaged observation note describes the local refusal and explicitly says that manual imitation remains possible.
actions.recovery: If the agent cannot derive a field from the prepared baseline or displayed refusal, stop rather than guessing.
actions.evidence: Check requires exact note bytes and the unchanged protected log. It does not authenticate the agent or harness transcript.

actions.title: Review the one-path observation boundary
actions.instruction: Review the draft before staging. The only learner commit path is `.codearbiter/reports/academy/U02-observation.md`; `.codearbiter/overrides.log` must remain unchanged. Audit and metrics are optional read-only observations, never input to Check's chronology proof.
actions.rationale: A one-path commit boundary prevents an observation exercise from mutating the audit trail it discusses.
actions.expected_result: You can accept the one-path note or identify the exact local field to correct.
actions.recovery: If another path changed, unstage it and correct only the note. Do not reset, amend, or rewrite audit history.
actions.evidence: Review is a learner action. No repository artifact can prove it occurred.

actions.title: Stage only the observation note
actions.instruction: After your review, stage exactly the observation note in a native terminal. Native-terminal commands never begin with `!`.
actions.rationale: The staged diff makes the permissible one-path boundary visible before the governed commit.
actions.recovery: If any other path is staged, unstage only that unexpected path and inspect again.
actions.evidence: The staged diff demonstrates scope, not the timing or cause of the refusal.

actions.title: Commit the observation through CodeArbiter
actions.instruction: After learner approval of the one-path staged diff, invoke the host-native commit gate. It is a CodeArbiter command and never a `!` shell passthrough.
actions.rationale: One child commit lets Check compare local evidence against the prepared state.
actions.expected_result: The attempt gains exactly one observation-note commit.
actions.recovery: If the gate blocks, preserve its finding and correct only the named note boundary. Do not amend or rewrite the attempt.
actions.evidence: A commit proves local paths and bytes, not a human approval or real-time harness event.

actions.title: Run the local U02 checkpoint
actions.instruction: Run Check in a native terminal. Native-terminal commands never begin with `!`.
actions.rationale: Check validates the prepared baseline, protected-log preservation, exact note shape, one commit, and clean worktree.
actions.expected_result: Check accepts only one clean observation-note commit with the protected audit log unchanged. It never claims refusal chronology.
actions.recovery: If Check reports a mismatch, correct only the note. Never touch the protected log.
actions.evidence: A pass is local deterministic evidence, not proof of a hosted action or an unforgeable harness event.

actions.title: Reset this attempt safely
actions.instruction: If the attempt cannot be corrected within its note boundary, use Academy Reset in a native terminal. Native-terminal commands never begin with `!`.
actions.rationale: Reset preserves the failed attempt rather than hiding it through history rewriting.
actions.expected_result: Academy archives the failed U02 attempt before preparing a new numbered attempt.
actions.recovery: Do not use destructive Git commands to imitate Reset or erase unrelated state.
actions.evidence: The archive is local recovery state, not proof that the observed refusal happened.
